회계감사의 분개 테스트(Journal Entry Testing)를 감사인: A work OS where auditors and AI agents perform journal entry testing together in financial audits. I am building it alone as my portfolio for the Samjong KPMG Audit Innovation Software Engineer application, learning Elixir from scratch along the way. It loads the general ledger (GL), runs eight test rules in parallel, attaches AI triage suggestions to entries selected by risk score, and records the preparer's conclusion and the reviewer's approval or rejection in an immutable audit log. The principle "AI suggests; people judge and sign off" is enforced by the data model and database constraints.

적중한 룰의 가중치 합으로 전표별 위험 점수(최대 100)를 계산하고,: Scored each entry by the sum of matched rule weights (capped at 100), and sent only entries at or above the threshold saved with each run (25 by default) to the review queue and AI triage.

저는 꿈이 한 가지 있습니다. 언젠가 대한민국의 IT유니콘 중 당당하게: I have a dream. I am Basilri Kim, and I want to build a company that earns its place among South Korea's IT unicorns. Through that company, I want to make everyday life more convenient and enjoyable.
처음에는 동적인 화면이 좋아 프론트엔드 개발자를 지향하였고, 커리어 시작: I initially wanted to become a frontend developer because I liked dynamic interfaces. Since starting my career, I have consistently worked with React.js, Next.js, Sass (SCSS), Redux, and Zustand. As I continued developing software, I became interested in backend work and began studying Node.js, Java, AWS, and computer science. More recently, I have also taken on backend tasks in company projects.
진정한 개발자란, 프론트엔드의 틀에만 갇혀 있지 않고 백엔드와 인프라도: I believe a developer should understand the backend and infrastructure as well as the frontend. When I first heard the term 'full-stack,' I thought it was unrealistic. After more than two years working in the field, however, I came to believe that understanding the full range of software development is part of proving my value as a developer.
언젠가는 오롯이 혼자서 프로젝트 구조설계, 화면 개발, 에러핸들링, 서버: One day, I want to have the skills to handle a whole project myself: architecture, interfaces, error handling, servers, security, and infrastructure.
